state_reviews.reason: Subtle head settling is visible between samples while the arms remain relaxed and feet retain their positions; this fits a gentle idle.
The head visibly turns through opposing orientations and returns to its starting pose while the body and feet remain stable.
The arm lifts, hand orientation changes and the arm returns to rest, but dangling stretched surfaces obscure a clean friendly hand wave.
The head visibly dips and rises while the torso and feet stay stable, matching the specifically requested modest celebratory nod.

review.summary: The robot matches the requested appearance and sampled restrained motions, but the waving arm needs a local deformation repair.
